# TINEA VERSICOLOR

Topical antifungals can be used for limited disease. For disease that involves nails or does not respond to topical therapy, use oral antifungals. Return of normal skin color often takes several weeks after the treatment course is finished.

## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Up-to-date
Sanford keyword: Tinea
AK Gupta AK, J Cutan Med Surg. 2014, 18:79
Therapy:
## Treatment limited disease:

Ketoconazole 2% shampoo apply to the affected area QDAY for 3 days. Apply to damp skin, lather, leave on 5 minutes, and rinse.
< OR >
Ketoconazole 2% cream to affected area QDAY for 14 days [M]
< OR >
Terbinafine 1% cream apply to affected area QDAY for 7 days [M]
< OR >
Selenium sulfide lotion 2.5% apply to affected area, leave on for 10 minutes, then rinse/shower thoroughly QDAY for 7 days [M]

## Treatment extensive disease:

Fluconazole 300 MG PO weekly for 2 weeks [R]
